teamMessages.message: Nice boos what’s up for today?

communications.content: Hi, I saw your ad on Google. I need my whole interior painted. 3 bedrooms, living room, and kitchen.
Hi Patricia! Thanks for reaching out. We'd love to help. When would be a good time for us to come take a look?
How about Thursday afternoon? I'm usually home after 2pm
Perfect, I'll schedule you for Thursday at 2:30pm. What's your address?
142 Oak Street, Hempstead NY 11550
Got it! See you Thursday at 2:30. I'll bring some color samples too.
Hi Patricia, just sent over your proposal for the interior painting. Let me know if you have any questions!
Looks good! Can you start next Monday?
Absolutely! We'll be there at 8am Monday. Please make sure the rooms are cleared. Thanks Patricia!
Everything looks amazing! Thank you so much. The colors are perfect.
Hey, got your number from my neighbor Patricia. She said you guys did a great job on her house. I need my exterior painted.
Hey Carlos! Glad to hear Patricia was happy. We'd love to take a look at your exterior. What's your availability this week?
I'm free Saturday morning if that works
Saturday at 10am works great. What's your address?
89 Maple Ave, Uniondale NY 11553
Carlos, just emailed you the estimate for the exterior. Includes power washing, priming, and 2 coats of Sherwin Williams Duration.
Price looks fair. When can you start?
We can start the week of Nov 18th weather permitting. I'll keep you posted!
House looks incredible. My wife loves the color. Thanks!
I need someone to paint my office space. About 2,000 sq ft. Multiple rooms.
Hi Robert! We do a lot of commercial work. Is this a professional office? When can we come measure?
Yes it's a dental office. We need it done on a weekend so we don't disrupt patients. Can you work Sat/Sun?
Absolutely, we do weekend work for commercial clients. I'll come by Tuesday to take measurements. What time works?
Come at lunch, 12-1pm. 456 Fulton Ave Suite 200
Proposal sent! We can knock it out in one weekend. Let me know what you think.
Approved. Let's do the first weekend of December.
You're booked for Dec 7-8. We'll have a 4-man crew. See you then!
Hi, I found you on Thumbtack. Looking for someone to paint my basement. It's about 800 sq ft.
Hi Lisa! Thanks for contacting us. We'd be happy to give you a free estimate. When works best for a walkthrough?
Maybe this weekend? I need to check with my husband
Good morning! I need the exterior of my colonial home repainted. It's been about 8 years since the last paint job.
Good morning Nancy! 8 years is about right for a repaint. We'd love to come take a look. Are you available this week?
Wednesday afternoon works. 22 Birch Lane, Garden City
See you Wednesday at 3pm! I'll bring our exterior color book.
Nancy, your proposal is ready. Includes scraping, priming bare spots, caulking, and 2 coats of Benjamin Moore Regal Select.
Can you do Revere Pewter for the body and White Dove for the trim?
Great choices! Those are two of our most popular colors. I'll update the proposal.
Approved! Let's get it done before the cold weather hits.
The house looks brand new! All the neighbors are asking who did it. I'll be leaving you a 5 star review.
Hey I need a quote for painting my kitchen cabinets. They're oak and I want them white.
Hi Ashley! Cabinet painting is one of our specialties. How many cabinets and do they have a lot of detail work?
About 25 doors and 12 drawer fronts. Shaker style so pretty simple
Perfect. Shaker is the easiest to spray. Can I come measure Wednesday?
Yes! 55 Cedar St, Levittown. Anytime after 3pm
Estimate sent! We spray all cabinets offsite in our shop for the best finish. Takes about 5 days total.
Love it. Let's do it after Christmas so the kitchen isn't torn up for the holidays
Smart thinking! I'll schedule you for Jan 6th. Happy holidays!
OMG the cabinets look like they came from a showroom! Best money I ever spent
I need my condo painted ASAP. Moving in next week. 2 bed 1 bath.
Hi Daniel! We can definitely work with a tight timeline. Can I come see it tomorrow?
Yes please. 78 Atlantic Ave Unit 4B, Freeport
I'll be there at 9am. Quick question - is the place empty or furnished?
Completely empty. Previous tenant moved out yesterday
Estimate sent. Since it's empty we can get it done in 2 days. Walls and ceilings included.
Done deal. Start whenever you can
Starting tomorrow morning! All done by Friday.
We're doing a full renovation on our Victorian home. Need interior and exterior painting. This is a big job.
Hi Karen! We love Victorian homes. Would love to see it. When can we schedule a walkthrough?
The sooner the better. Our contractor needs the painting schedule to plan everything else.
I can come today at 4pm if that works?
Perfect. 310 Nassau Blvd, Rockville Centre. Ask for Karen at the front door.
Karen, detailed proposal sent. Broke it into phases so it works with your renovation timeline. Phase 1: Interior prep and paint. Phase 2: Exterior after siding is done.
This is very thorough. My husband and I reviewed it. We're good to go.
Wonderful! We'll coordinate with your GC on the schedule. Looking forward to it!
The house is stunning. Every visitor comments on the paint job. You guys are artists!
Hi there, I need my deck stained. It's a 400 sq ft composite deck that's looking pretty faded.
Hi Susan! We do a lot of deck work. Composite decks need special prep. When can I come take a look?
This Saturday morning? 19 Willow Dr, Massapequa
Saturday at 10am works. I'll bring some stain samples. Do you have a color preference?
Something in a walnut or dark brown
Estimate is in your email! Includes full cleaning, sanding, and 2 coats of Cabot Australian Timber Oil in Dark Walnut.
Looks good. Go ahead!
Need a quote for painting my restaurant. We're rebranding and need new colors throughout.
Hi Mark! Restaurant rebrands are exciting. What kind of restaurant? And is this during business hours or after?
Italian place. We close Mondays and Tuesdays. Can you work those days?
Absolutely. I'll come by Monday to measure and discuss the new brand colors.
Proposal sent! Broke it into the dining area, bar, restrooms, and kitchen. Each can be done on a Monday-Tuesday cycle.
This is great. Starting with the dining room next Monday works?
Booked! Dining room first, then we'll work through the rest. Invoice will go out after completion of each phase.
Mark, dining room and bar are done. Invoice sent for the first phase. The remaining sections are scheduled for next week.
Looking amazing. Customers are already noticing. I'll get the payment out this week.
Hey, I have a 4-unit apartment building I need painted. All interiors between tenants.
Hi Steven! We do a lot of landlord work. How many units are currently vacant?
2 vacant now, the other 2 leases end in March. Can we start with the empty ones?
Smart approach. I'll come look at them this week. What's the address?
221 Grand Ave, Baldwin. Units 1A and 2B are empty
Proposal sent for all 4 units with a volume discount. We can start the vacant ones next week.
Price is right. Let's go!
Units 1A and 2B are done. They look great. Ready for your new tenants! We'll schedule 1B and 2A when they vacate in March.
Perfect. I already have showings lined up. The paint looks clean and fresh.
Need my garage epoxy coated. 2-car garage, about 500 sq ft.
Hi Thomas! Epoxy floors are awesome. Do you want a solid color or a flake finish?
Flake finish, something gray. Like the ones I see on YouTube
The charcoal flake is our best seller. Can I come measure this week? The floor needs to be prepped properly for epoxy to stick.
Friday works. 67 Pine St, Wantagh
Proposal sent! Includes diamond grinding, moisture test, base coat, flake broadcast, and clear top coat. 3-day process.
Let's do it in January. Garage needs to be empty for 3 days right?
Correct, 3 days no foot traffic, 7 days before parking on it. I'll schedule you for Jan 13th.
This floor is insane! My buddies are all jealous. Thanks man!
Hey I was referred by Carlos. Need my fence and shed painted. Can you guys do that?
Hi David! Yes we do fences and sheds. Is it wood or vinyl fence?
Wood fence, about 200 linear ft. The shed is 10x12.
I can come by this weekend to take a look. Saturday morning?
Sounds good. 45 Elm Court, Merrick
Proposal sent! Includes fence staining (Olympic Elite in Dark Oak) and shed painting to match your house trim color.
Approved! When can you schedule it?
We're looking at early March when weather is consistently above 50 degrees. I'll confirm the exact date next week.
I just bought a fixer-upper. Needs everything painted. Walls, ceilings, trim, doors. The works.
Hi James! Congrats on the new home. How big is the house and when do you need it done by?
It's about 1,800 sq ft, 3 bed 2 bath Cape Cod. We want to move in by mid-March if possible.
That's doable. Can I see it this week? Empty house means we can move fast.
Tomorrow at noon? 88 Shore Rd, Bellmore
Full proposal sent. Includes skim coating the ceilings (they need it), all walls, trim, doors, and closet interiors. Benjamin Moore throughout.
My wife picked the colors. We're in. When do you start?
Starting Monday Feb 17th with a 3-man crew. Should be done in about 8 working days.
James, bedrooms are done. Kitchen and living room starting tomorrow. Everything is looking great!
Stopped by today. It looks incredible already! Can't wait to move in.
Patricia called asking about paint color options for the bedroom. Discussed Benjamin Moore Simply White vs Chantilly Lace. She'll decide before we start.
Called Carlos to confirm start date. He confirmed Nov 18th works. Will move cars out of driveway.
Robert called about scheduling. Wants to push to Dec 14-15 instead. Dental office has a conference on the 7th.
Called Nancy to discuss trim colors. She wants to add the front door in a darker accent color - Wrought Iron. Updated proposal.
Ashley called about timeline. Wants to confirm January 6th is still on track. Confirmed.
Called Karen to coordinate with her GC on Phase 2 timeline. Exterior work can start Sept 15 after siding is complete.
Karen called about adding crown molding painting to the scope. Discussed pricing and she approved the change order.
Called Mark to discuss the bar area colors. He wants a darker accent wall behind the bar. Going with Hale Navy by BM.
Steven called asking about pricing for the remaining 2 units. Confirmed same rate. Will schedule when tenants move out.
Called James to discuss ceiling texture. Recommended smooth skim coat instead of popcorn. He agreed. Added to scope.
James called about adding the basement to the project. Will send updated proposal tomorrow.
Called David to discuss fence stain options. Went with semi-transparent for a natural wood look. Will start when weather permits.
